note: Exploratory text- and date-conditioned diffusion over tool silhouettes. Registered before any model was trained or sampled: data, splits, model, training budget, guidance, metrics, baselines and the decision rule below are fixed. Generated outlines are 2D form hypotheses from single uncalibrated photographs; they carry no scale, mechanism, material or function and are not designs.
decision_rule: The generator is said to add information beyond retrieval only if the paired difference (generator text+date minus retrieval_text) in mean-of-k IoU and in mean-of-k DINO cosine both have 95% intervals above zero. Otherwise the result is reported as no evidence of generation beyond retrieval. For retro1850 the rule applies to the pooled result over the three seeds.
known_issue: 114 Region Skåne records are named 'seaweed' (a probable machine translation of Swedish 'tång', tongs/forceps). Names are used as recorded; the issue is reported, not corrected.
